text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond was unusually nervous for 
the Kyoto Daishoten. However, she insisted 
that she was fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She explains that the reason her running 
fell apart was because she felt obligated 
to run like a "famous Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, wanting to become a "renowned 
Umamusume" was her own personal wish. She 
said it helped her remember the joy of 
running out of her own desire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond vowed to run true to 
herself, and headed off toward the race.
